title: Unsloth Dynamic 3.0 GGUFs
summary: Unsloth introduces Dynamic 3.0 GGUFs, a new format that dynamically adjusts quantization levels during inference to optimize memory usage and speed without sacrificing quality. It simplifies deployment by auto-selecting optimal bit-widths per layer, reducing manual tuning. Aimed at LLM practitioners, it promises faster, more efficient local inference on consumer hardware.
